title: MiCoreX
description: MI-CoreX Plugin With Best Maintance System Of Paper , Spigot , Bukkit
body:
# MI-CoreX – Advanced Maintenance Plugin

⚡ Clean. Powerful. Fully Configurable.

MI-CoreX is a lightweight yet powerful maintenance plugin designed for modern Minecraft servers (Paper/Spigot).
Easily toggle maintenance mode, control player access, and display a premium server list experience with gradient MOTD support.

![Motd When Mi Is Enabled!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/983fda3ae3b77f5ec47b55bab866d8761475f361.png)

---

🔥 Features

✅ One Command Control

* /mi on → Enable maintenance mode
* /mi off → Disable maintenance mode

👥 Smart Access System

* OP players can always join
* Add/remove players:

  * /mi add <player>
  * /mi remove <player>

🎨 Premium MOTD System

* Custom 2-line MOTD during maintenance
* Gradient color support (HEX based)
* Clean and modern server list appearance

💾 Config + Command Sync

* Works via config.yml AND commands
* Automatically saves state (no reset on restart)

🚫 Custom Kick Messages

* Fully configurable
* Multi-line support
* Clean professional UI

⚙️ Advanced Settings

* Fake player count (server lock look)
* Toggle kick-on-enable
* Easy customization

---

📦 Commands

/mi on
/mi off
/mi add <player>
/mi remove <player>
/mi help

---

🔐 Permissions

mi.admin

---

⚙️ Configuration

* Fully customizable config.yml
* Gradient MOTD colors
* Custom messages
* Maintenance toggle
* Allowed players list

---

🎯 Compatibility

✔ Minecraft 1.20+ / 1.21+
✔ Paper / Spigot / Purpur
✔ Java 21 recommended

---

💡 Why MI-CoreX?

* ⚡ Lightweight & fast
* 🎨 Premium visuals (gradient MOTD)
* 🧠 Smart system (config + command sync)
* 🛠️ Clean developer structure
